payload.rationale: Selected from 8 validation-only trials. Builds on the best prior resnet18 result (0.9908) by increasing hidden 32→48 and depth 3→4 for ~30% more capacity, while raising dropout to 0.15 and lowering lr to 3e-4 to maintain stability. Enables class_weighting to explicitly address the 1.63× class imbalance (minority classes at 7.9K vs majority at 12.9K). Adds rotate180 as a third augmentation for broader spatial invariance. Label smoothing increased to 0.1 for better calibration on the 9-class problem. All other hyperparameters (batch 128, AdamW, cosine, standardize, wd=1e-4) match the proven best configuration.
